nativeFinding.text: Witness does not support liaoshi:106:p007 in s0019, quote 林牙斡魯之孫.

diagnosis: Native gate is correct: the substring 林牙斡魯之孫 is not a personal-name witness for p007. It is the grandson line on biography subject 耶律官奴 (p002). p007 is a strongly-inferred intervening parent with no independent surface; the sealed extraction already records descriptive-kinship on s0019. Owner evidence incorrectly attributed the full s0019 sentence to localId p007 as if it named that record.

correctedWitnesses.quote: 耶律官奴，字奚隱，林牙斡魯之孫。
correctedWitnesses.reading: Named biography subject and explicit grandson-to-斡魯 linkage.
Grandson relation implies one unnamed intervening parent between 林牙斡魯 (p006) and 官奴 (p002); not a personal Chinese name for p007.
